delhi.note: Densest monitoring network in India; includes DPCC + CPCB + IMD stations

mumbai.note: Includes MPCB + CPCB stations; Worli, Bandra, Andheri, Colaba among key sites

kolkata.note: WBPCB network; Victoria, Rabindra Bharati, Fort William among key sites

chennai.note: TNPCB network; Alandur, Manali, Velachery among key sites

bangalore.note: KSPCB network; Peenya, BTM, Silk Board, Hebbal among key sites

hyderabad.note: TSPCB network; Sanathnagar, Zoo Park, Balanagar among key sites

lucknow.note: UPPCB network; Lalbagh, Talkatora among key sites

patna.note: BSPCB network; IGSC Planetarium, Muradpur, Samanpura among CAAQMS sites; manual stations at Rajbansi Nagar, Khajpura, Gardanibagh, Phulwari Sharif

pune.note: MPCB network; Shivajinagar, Lohegaon, Katraj among key sites

jaipur.note: RSPCB network; Adarsh Nagar, Shastri Nagar among key sites

varanasi.note: UPPCB + CPCB stations; Ardhali Bazaar among key sites

agra.note: UPPCB network; Sanjay Place among key sites

gurgaon.note: HSPCB network; Sector 51, Teri Gram, Vikas Sadan among key sites

noida.note: UPPCB network; Sector 125, Sector 62 among key sites

ghaziabad.note: UPPCB network; Vasundhara, Indirapuram among key sites

delhi.note: Most polluted capital globally (IQAir 2025). 0 days met WHO limit in 2026.

kolkata.note: Winter inversions + vehicle emissions. Limited monitoring coverage.

lucknow.note: Indo-Gangetic plain — trapped pollutants. Brick kilns major source.

patna.note: Among worst PM2.5 in India. Limited enforcement capacity.

varanasi.note: PM2.5 fell 72% in 5 years — best NCAP performer.

jaipur.note: Desert dust + vehicle emissions. Seasonal variation high.

pune.note: Relatively better air quality than Delhi/Mumbai. Growing vehicle fleet a concern.

chennai.note: Coastal city — sea breeze helps dispersion. Industrial corridor a concern.

bangalore.note: Generally better air quality. Vehicle growth and construction are rising concerns.

sources.iqair_annual: IQAir World Air Quality Report 2025 (March 2025, covering 2024 data)
